notes: Every number on a card is the number the job uses. A fade asked for 3 seconds on a short clip now shows the length it will actually apply, rather than one the render quietly shortens. Trimming 1.5 seconds says 1.5, not 2. Asking for a frame rate below 48 — “make it 40fps” — is understood instead of answered with “I didn't catch an edit in that”, and the card names the rate you will actually get.
